item.text: OpenJDK 21 defaults to G1 GC, which prioritizes shorter, more predictable pauses while retaining good throughput ([JDK 21 GC guide](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/21/gctuning/hotspot-virtual-machine-garbage-collection-tuning-guide.pdf)). OpenJDK 8 defaults to Parallel GC on server-class machines, favoring maximum throughput—though JVM ergonomics may select Serial GC on constrained configurations ([JDK 8 GC guide](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/technotes/guides/vm/gctuning/parallel.html)).
